demo.prompt: I'm about to build an admin dashboard for a small online store (orders, revenue, customers). Research it first. Standard depth.
demo.result:
A brief with 38 principles, 14 anti-patterns and 12 pain points from 56 sources, ending in a 15-item build checklist. Three of its items:

1. Write down one definition for every sales figure, using the gross sales, net sales, total sales ladder, and show the formula in a tooltip on the card. [13][11][17][41]
6. Make every metric card open the list or report it counts, and put a "needs action" block on the home page next to the charts. [10][12][2][19]
8. Add row checkboxes with a bulk action bar, and keep the selection across paging, search and live refresh. [29][51][54]

*Subagents mode: 6 researchers and 6 auditors. 85 claims audited: 81 confirmed, 4 narrowed, 0 dropped. About 22 minutes.*
demo.caption: Real output, shortened. The numbers in brackets are the sources each item cites.

before.label: Same build request, no research
before.text:
"Build me an admin dashboard for a small online store. Show me orders, revenue and customers."

![Dashboard built without research](/showcase/principle-research-before.jpg)

13 of 20 professional details. It shows numbers, with search, sorting, paging and dark mode.
before.note: Already a decent dashboard, built in about 5 minutes. Adding one sentence, "research how professional store admins work first", scored 16 of 20 in about 12 minutes, so much of the gain is cheap.

after.label: Built from the principle-research brief
after.text:
The same request, with the brief to read first.

![Dashboard built from the brief](/showcase/principle-research-after.jpg)

19 of 20. It adds how each number is counted, a "needs action now" list, separate payment and fulfilment status, a side panel per order, bulk actions, CSV export, saved views, undo and an activity log.
after.note: Neither build has a command palette: no source for it passed the audit, so the brief left it out and said so. The build took about 18 minutes.

method: One run each, same request, same model (Claude Fable 5.2) and same tools, November 2026. The second build was also given the brief from a full run. The skill now also has a light run of about 3 minutes for ordinary builds, which was tested for its checklist but not scored this way. The 20 details were listed before either build was opened.
